name: Uta Kawagichi
source:
Inside every person, an eternal conflict rages between the essence of humanity and the encroaching grasp of inhuman decay; a ceaseless battle where the forces of virtue may reign supreme for decades, only to succumb to the shadows in a single tragic moment. In this enduring struggle, Uta emerges as a beacon of moral guidance, an impartial observer whose sage counsel can tip the scales in favor of righteousness.

Despite the shockingly hyperbolic nature of her sermons on hygiene Uta's approach has consistently proven effective in detecting and containing disease outbreaks. Her unwavering commitment to cleanliness is matched only by her profound sense of duty to her community. Though many may bristle at Uta's stringent instructions, the undeniable positive outcomes speak for themselves.

As Uta begins her journey at Bitokukawa, her greatest challenge lies in persuading others to embrace her unique quirks and methods. Despite her classmates often perceiving her presence as more akin to a supernatural phenomenon than that of a normal person, she remains steadfast in her determination to establish herself as a capable and trustworthy student.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1gcirux/meet_uta_the_former_ultimate_epidemiologist/]bio[/url]]
